text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“—And they lived happily ever after.
That's all for today's picture book.”

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child A
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun!
Thank you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm so glad
the bunnies and squirrels all became good friends~.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome.
Thank you all for listening, too.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child C
text_block_list.text:
Mmph... That was so boring!!
Fighting, saying sorry,
and making up is totally lame!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that right?
Then next time, I'll find a picture book
that you'll like too.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Child C
text_block_list.text:
! Really?!
Then for me—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...And that's pretty much what happened.

On the way home from going out with K.S.Miracle,
I listened to her talk about the children she met at the hospital.
choice_data_list: A story about beating up bad guys...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And apparently, stories where
they beat them up with... kicks and punches
are what they like best.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There are picture books about defeating bad guys,
but none that are overly violent...
So I'm a bit unsure of what to do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
According to her, regular picture books
just lack impact and leave her unsatisfied.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hero stories do have special moves and such, but... when it comes to the kind of impact that child is looking for in a picture book...
K.S.Miracle paces around the picture book corner, looking troubled.

You certainly don't see picture books with that kind of intensity in children's literature very often.
As I wondered what to do—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I like happy endings.
Stories with a calm, gentle atmosphere...
where you can picture what happens next even after it ends.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: “Though that's really just my personal preference. The kids seem to like happy endings, too, but...”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There really are all kinds of kids, after all.
If only there was a picture book that made everyone
happy, not just a select few...
choice_data_list: How about adding some sound effects?
How about trying to make the picture bigger?

text_block_list.text:
If all we need is a sense of power,
we might be able to manage even without
throwing punches or kicks.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sound effects... like bird calls, rustling, and things like that, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Sound would certainly give it much more impact!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Making sounds along with the picture book...
Louder sounds might be difficult, but I can certainly set the mood.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
I'll go look for some sounds I can use right away.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, before that, I need to find a picture book where sound can be put to good use...!
K.S. Miracle's eyes sparkle with excitement, just like a child's.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll be in your care.
...Fufu, I'm sure everyone
will be delighted.

—A few days later. The sounds matching the picture book's scenes
brought joyful smiles to the children's faces.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Make the pictures bigger...
Then a kamishibai picture story is the way to go!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Making it bigger than usual,
so you can see it from anywhere in the room...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds great!
I'd love to try it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Drawing it myself... might be difficult.
In that case, printing...
Ahaha, this looks like it's going to be a huge undertaking.
choice_data_list: It's gonna feel so rewarding once it's done!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right!
Let's give all the kids a big surprise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah.
I just went and dragged you into this without even asking, Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'm already raring to go, though!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, yes!
With you by my side, Trainer, I feel like I can take on a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oooh! ...Ahaha.

—A few days later. Children with sparkling eyes
gathered in the hospital playroom.
